own_solution.law: Kinetic theory of an ideal gas: v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M)
assumptions: ideal classical gas in thermal equilibrium (stated)

defect_reasons.other: TB146 ('Just before the molecular speeds were measured, a heater warmed this gas sample by 100 K') admits a minority reading in which the stated 300 K is the temperature at measurement; the certified reading (300 K before heating, 400 K at measurement) is the natural one, so this is a wording issue only.

notes: Checked certified answers: T=300 K: sqrt(3*8.314*300/0.004) = sqrt(1870650) = 1367.72 m/s; T=350: sqrt(2182425) = 1477.30; T=400: sqrt(2494200) = 1579.30; T=500: sqrt(3117750) = 1765.715, certified 1765.72 (rounding at the half, within precision). Relations and unit handling (M in kg/mol, Ek in J/mol) are consistent. The cancellation of n for TB16B/T852B is correct: sqrt(2*(3/2)nRT/(nM)) = sqrt(3RT/M); both state 2 mol. Minimal pairs hold: T424E/T2283 differ only in 'the other sample' vs 'this gas sample', same 100 K; TD47F/TB146 differ only in 'In an earlier experiment' vs 'Just before the molecular speeds were measured', same 100 K. TC1EA and T0AD1 are declared numeral-free controls, consistent with my pass-1 reading. The thermally insulated second flask is correctly D. Agreement with pass 1 on all strata and answers.
